name: blueprint/linked-notes
description: An interlinked markdown KB in the store: notes carry links, extract keeps the backlinks fresh, traversal is a prefix scan
recipe: write a note -> extract its links and store backlinks on the targets -> traverse the graph by prefix scan -> summarize hub notes into digests
pitfalls: the store is prefix-scan only - no graph queries, design keys for it
backlinks live on the record, refreshed on edit
